variants.about_this_item: Beaphar BIO Sensitive Shampoo for Dogs is an effective, eco-friendly shampoo containing organically produced active ingredients. Our unique, non-irritant formula has a neutral pH and is free from parabens, silicons and colourants. The Beaphar BIO Range is not only great for pets, but it’s good for the environment too. ECOCERT® certified products contain natural active ingredients, but they also need to come from respectful production with strict standards regarding toxicity and biodegradability. This certification takes multiple factors into account in order to make sure that the manufacturer has an ethical and respectful approach in regard to the environment. In addition, the bottles and tubes used in the Beaphar BIO Range are made from sustainably sourced sugarcane, which is a 100% renewable and recyclable. Beaphar BIO Sensitive Shampoo for Dogs contains organically produced Aloe vera gel to moisturise your dog’s skin and leave their coat beautifully soft. The shampoo, which is enriched with St. John’s wort and blackcurrant, nourishes and protects your dog’s coat, helping to soothe sensitive and irritated skin. Suitable for both long and short-haired dogs.
variants.ingredient_information: Composition: AQUA, ALOE BARBADENSIS LEAF EXTRACT*, AMMONIUM LAURYL SULFATE, COCAMIDOPROPYL BETAINE, GLYCERIN, BENZYL ALCOHOL, SODIUM CHLORIDE, SALICYLIC ACID, SODIUM HYDROXIDE, PARFUM, GLUCONOLACTONE, BENZOIC ACID, DEHYDROACETIC ACID, SODIUM BENZOATE, HELIANTHUS ANNUUS SEED OIL*, RIBES NIGRUM FRUIT EXTRACT, CALCIUM GLUCONATE, MALTODEXTRIN, CITRIC ACID, CENTELLA ASIATICA EXTRACT*, HYPERICUM PERFORATUM EXTRACT*, POTASSIUM SORBATE.
variants.feeding_instructions: ALWAYS FULLY READ THE PRODUCT LABEL BEFORE USE. 1. Wet your dog’s coat with warm water. 2. Massage the shampoo into the coat until it lathers, taking care to avoid the eyes, ears, nose and mouth. 3. Rinse and repeat as required. 4. Dry the coat well. Keep your dog indoors until the coat is fully dry.
